candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, causing order to fail and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502. Traces show payment 503 as the deepest failing dependency in each checkout chain; inventory/redis succeed.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side logs/metrics excluded; root cause within payment (config, saturation) not established.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s correlate with payment 503s in traces; inventory and redis succeed. Gateway metrics show 16 502s on /v1/checkout. Payment-side evidence is excluded, so the specific payment fault is unconfirmed.
missing_evidence: Payment service logs and metrics for /v1/authorizations during the incident window
Payment dependency topology and downstream health to explain the 503
